messages:
Alex: quick sync — console PR #412 depends on api PR #298 (auth header change). I can hold the console merge until SDK bump lands, but need approvals so we don't block monday deploy. @Maya can you review console?
Maya: looking now, should be quick. main question: do we want the new header to be optional for a rollout?
Alex: yes make it opt-in via `X-RW-Auth-Version: 2` so runtime can fallback. console toggles are behind feature flag `console.authv2`.
Sven: SDK needs a tiny shim for the header parsing. I have a draft in sdk PR #120 that adds `parseAuthHeaderV2`. Will ping owners after tests.
Jo: FYI helm chart also needs a minor values change to set the feature flag for staging. I'll open a follow-up chart PR.
Alex: cool — plan: 1) merge API #298 after Maya approves, 2) merge SDK #120, 3) merge console #412 with flag off by default, 4) chart PR to enable flag in staging for canary. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
Maya: approved API #298. left one tiny comment about a log line, not blocking. :white_check_mark:
Sven: sdk CI green, PTAL @Alex. I added a changelog entry.
Alex: saw it, looks good. I'll wait for Jo's helm PR before merging console so we can test end-to-end in staging.
Jo: helm PR #55 opened — sets `console.featureFlags.authv2: true` in staging values, false in prod. link: https://git.internal/helm/charts/pulls/55
Lisa: heads-up: ops wants a rollback plan in case old clients break. Can we add a quick smoke test in the rollout?
Alex: yes — plan to canary to 10% on staging first and run `auth-compat` smoke script. snippet:
```
#!/bin/bash
# auth-compat smoke
for url in $(cat staging-instances.txt); do
  curl -s -H "X-RW-Auth-Version: 2" "$url/health" || echo "fail $url"
  curl -s "$url/health" || echo "legacy fail $url"
done
```
Alex: deploy-bot — please schedule a canary once console + api + sdk are merged to staging.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for cluster staging at 2024-02-12T16:30:00Z, ID c-20240212-16:30. Logs will stream to #eng-releases.
Maya: merging API now.
Sven: merging SDK after final CI.
Jo: will merge helm after SDK is merged.
Alex: thanks all — will post a short postmortem if anything goes sideways. If no issues, I'll flip the prod flag next week during the maintenance window. :rocket:
